QuestInfo.name: [Forest of Endurance] The Pink Anthurium
QuestInfo.0: #p1103003# was once a Cygnus Knight, but left to investigate #m101000000#. He has a reputation for being VERY suspicious of everything. That being said, he claims to have found something... well, suspicious. You might want to check it out, just in case.
QuestInfo.1: Hersha is suspicious of Shane's Herb Garden and wants you to get this herb called #bPink Anthurium#k. \r\nTalk to #bShane#k first.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You gave Hersha the flower and now you'll be allowed to enter the Forest of Endurance without paying Shane any fees. You should definitely take advantage of this.

0.0: Aaahh! It's you! You're a spy from the Black Wings, aren't you? No? Perhaps I can trust you. There's a huge conspiracy going on, RIGHT HERE in #m101000000#! It's up to us to save everyone. Can you help me, not-spy?
0.1: Hey, hey. Do you know Shane? No? I think something's going on in his forest. Get me one of his herbs.

yes.0: Hm, first get me a #b#t4031020##k. It looks like this #i4031020# thing.
yes.1: Yes! I'll explain to you about the herb you'll be getting for me. Remember there are similar herbs around so make sure you know this. The herb you'll need to get is #b#t4031020##k, and the flower looks like this #i4031020#. Look carefully and please get the same one as I described for you.

no.0: You don't want to protect #m101000000#? Ah HA! I knew it! You ARE a spy for the Black Wings! I'm calling in backup right now to bring you in! You just wait there. No moving!

1.0: Where are the bananas? Bring them to me! We have to get them away from the Lupins! Only I can be trusted, so bring them to me!

yes.0: Hm, this smells like a regular flower. This doesn't mean we can rest! The enemies might have switched them out with one of these regular ones.

1.1: Oh, I almost forgot. Since you helped me out, I should thank you for your hard work. Here, take this scroll. My brother made this for me a while back, and it adds to the guarding abilities of the armor. Hopefully you'll use it well. And from here on out, #p1032003# will let you in for free. Thanks for your help...

item.0: Not yet? Something bad is going to happen if you don't hurry! Remember, like this: #i4031020# Go to #m101000000# and get that herb from #p1032003#'s forest.
